title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
1937年5月。黑山县。黑虎山，黑风寨。这是曾经名声响彻整个锦川有名的土匪窝。此刻，黑风寨里来了几名不速之客。只见这几人身上背着土铳，每个人的头顶都扎着一块白色布巾。为首的一人，背上还背着一把三八式步枪。他们都是来自黑山县游击队。自1931年9月8日，东北沦陷之后。东三省就涌现出了许许多多的由东三省各地抗倭志士自发组建的抗倭游击队。黑山县游击队便是其中之一。论谁都没有想到，就这样一支抗倭队伍，竟然会派人来到名声狼藉的黑虎山黑风寨。与当地的土匪头子碰面。“杨成大当家，总算是见着你了。”黑风寨的大厅内。黑山县游击队的队长沈建武看见了杨成，也总算是松了一口气。整整一日，沈建武都没有任何的休息。带着手底下的几个士兵，没有任何停顿。只为赶在倭军之前来给黑风寨报信。“沈队长，你可是我黑风寨的贵客啊。”“王大年，赶紧让人给沈队长上几杯热茶。”看着气喘吁吁来给自己报信的几人。杨成先是诧异，而后便对着身后的二当家王大年吩咐道。只见在杨成的命令下，王大年立马就带着两个手下给沈建武几人端上了几杯热白开。“沈队长，先喝口茶，休息一下。”“有什么事情可以慢慢细说。”杨成对着沈建武不紧不慢地说道。“我不喝茶。”“杨大当家的，我来是想要告诉你一件事。”“我得到消息，倭军马上就要朝着黑虎山这边过来了。”“这一次，他们的目的就是为了剿灭你们黑风寨。”看着杨成不紧不慢一脸悠闲的样子。沈建武连忙将王大年递过来的热白开给推到了一边，一脸焦急地说道。“倭军朝着我们黑虎山来了？”“要剿匪？”听见了沈建武的话，整个大厅内在场的黑风寨众人都眉头紧锁。他们没有想到，倭军竟然这么快就盯上他们黑风寨。一时间，一股肃杀紧迫感瞬间笼罩在众人的心头。

只有杨成，表现得依旧淡定。“沈队长，辛苦你们跑这一趟来给我们送信了。”“你还有其他事吗？”“如果没有其他事，那你们就下山去吧。”“既然倭军是奔着我们黑虎山来的，那么我们自然也不能够连累你们。”杨成神色如常地对着沈建武说道。听到杨成的话，沈建武立马就急了。“下山？”“杨成？我和几个弟兄一刻都不敢耽搁，跑了二十多公里山路来给你们通风报信。”“到了这里，你就只是让我们下山？”“沈队长，我很感谢你们专程跑一趟。”“倭军会来犯我黑风寨，其实只是时间早晚的问题。”“我绝不能让你们几个也跟着在这里受牵连。”杨成再次用肯定的语气说道。“杨成，倭军离这里大概还有七八里路。”“我来是想告诉你们，你们抢先一步撤离还来得及。”沈建武强行压下自己内心的焦躁，对着杨成说道。“沈队长，我们不是你们抗倭游击队，我们就是一帮人人喊打的土匪。”“撤离？你让我们能撤到哪里去？”“我们不像你们游击队，到哪里都有百姓的拥护，帮着你们打掩护。”“我们一旦离开这黑虎山，那几乎就是人人喊打。”“别说倭军想要歼灭我们，其他人一样对我们是恨得咬牙切齿，哪里还能有我们这帮土匪的容身之处呢？”杨成笑了笑说道。“杨成，你别在这里和我开这种玩笑了。”“你们是土匪？”“别人不知道，我还不知道吗？”“原本的黑风寨的那帮土匪早就被你们给消灭干净了，你们这么些年，藏在这里，无非就是借着土匪的名头躲避倭军的追捕而已。”沈建武一语就将杨成的话给点破。事实上，杨成带的这帮人马全部都不是黑风寨的原班人马。而是曾经大夏国东北军麾下的一支连队。在东北军撤离东北之后，杨成他们不愿意撤离东北。想要留在东北继续抗倭。所以才占据了黑虎山，借着土匪的名义。暗自发展以及进行着各种抗倭活动。换句话说，杨成带的这一支黑风寨的队伍。就是一支披着土匪外皮的抗倭游击队。虽然为了生存，也劫掠过沿路的一些商队。但是杨成他们都是只挑那些为倭军效力的大汉奸下手。

May 1937.Black Mountain County.Black Tiger Mountain, Black Wind Village.This was a bandit's den that was once famous throughout Jinchuan.At this moment, several uninvited guests came to Heifeng Village.I saw these people carrying guns on their backs, and each of them had a white cloth tied on their head.The leader was carrying a Type 38 rifle on his back.They are all from the Heishan County guerrillas.Since September 8, 1931, after the fall of Northeast China.Many anti-Japanese guerrillas formed spontaneously by anti-Japanese patriots from all over the three northeastern provinces.The Heishan County guerrillas are one of them.No one expected that such an anti-Japanese team would send people to the infamous Black Tiger Mountain and Black Wind Village.Meet the local bandit leader."Master Yang Cheng, I finally see you." In the hall of Black Wind Village.Shen Jianwu, the captain of the Heishan County guerrillas, finally breathed a sigh of relief when he saw Yang Cheng.For a whole day, Shen Jianwu didn't have any rest.With a few soldiers under his command, there was no pause.Just to report the news to Heifeng Village before the Japanese army."Captain Shen, you are a distinguished guest of my Black Wind Village." "Wang Danian, hurry up and get someone to serve Captain Shen a few cups of hot tea." He looked at the panting people who came to report to him.Yang Cheng was surprised at first, and then ordered Wang Danian, the second master behind him.Under Yang Cheng's order, Wang Danian immediately brought two of his men to serve several cups of hot water to Shen Jianwu and the others."Captain Shen, let's take a sip of tea and take a rest." "If you have anything, you can tell me in detail." Yang Cheng said to Shen Jianwu in a leisurely manner."I don't drink tea." "Master Yang, I'm here to tell you something." "I got news that the Japanese army is coming to Black Tiger Mountain soon." "This time, their purpose is to wipe out your Black Wind Village." Looking at Yang Cheng's leisurely look.Shen Jianwu quickly pushed aside the hot white drink Wang Danian handed over and said anxiously."The Japanese army is coming towards our Black Tiger Mountain?" "Are they going to suppress the bandits?" After hearing Shen Jianwu's words, everyone in the Heifeng Village frowned in the entire hall.They did not expect that the Japanese army would target their Heifeng Village so quickly.For a moment, a sense of chilling urgency enveloped everyone's hearts.

Only Yang Cheng remained calm."Captain Shen, you have come all the way to deliver the message to us." "Do you have anything else to do?" "If there is nothing else, then you can go down the mountain." "Since the Japanese army is coming to our Black Tiger Mountain, then naturally we can't harm you." Yang Cheng said to Shen Jianwu with a normal expression.After hearing Yang Cheng's words, Shen Jianwu immediately became anxious."Go down the mountain?" "Yang Cheng? My brothers and I didn't dare to delay for a moment. We traveled more than 20 kilometers on the mountain road to inform you." "When we get here, you just let us go down the mountain?" "Captain Shen, I am very grateful to you for making a special trip." "It is only a matter of time before the Japanese army invades our Heifeng Stronghold." "I will never let you guys be implicated here." Yang Cheng said again in a positive tone."Yang Cheng, the Japanese army is still about seven or eight miles away from here." "I'm here to tell you that it's still too late for you to evacuate first." Shen Jianwu suppressed his inner anxiety and said to Yang Cheng."Captain Shen, we are not your anti-Japanese guerrillas. We are just a bunch of bandits that everyone wants to fight." "Evacuate? Where can you allow us to evacuate?" "We are not like your guerrillas. We have the support of the people wherever we go to help you cover."Once we leave Black Tiger Mountain, almost everyone is shouting to beat us.""Not to mention that the Japanese army wants to annihilate us. Others hate us with gnashing of teeth. Where can we find a place for bandits?"Yang Cheng said with a smile."Yang Cheng, don't make such a joke with me here." "You are bandits?" "Others don't know, but I don't know?" "The original bandits in Heifeng Village have been wiped out by you long ago. You have been hiding here for so many years, just using the name of bandits to avoid the pursuit of the Japanese army." Shen Jianwu revealed Yang Cheng's words with one sentence.In fact, all the people led by Yang Cheng were not the original members of Heifeng Village.It was a company that was once part of the Northeastern Army of the Great Xia Kingdom.After the Northeast Army withdrew from the Northeast, Yang Cheng and others were unwilling to withdraw from the Northeast.I want to stay in the Northeast and continue to fight against the Japanese.That's why we occupied Black Tiger Mountain, in the name of bandits.Secretly developing and carrying out various anti-Japanese activities.In other words, the Black Wind Village team led by Yang Cheng.It is an anti-Japanese guerrilla force dressed in bandit skin.Although in order to survive, they also robbed some caravans along the road.But Yang Cheng and others only picked those big traitors who served the Japanese army.
